sources.title: Gerald Teschl, Mathematical Methods in Quantum Mechanics: With Applications to Schrödinger Operators, 2nd edition (2014), author-hosted full book

contents.name: §2.3: closed semibounded forms and their associated operator representation
contents.support: The source gives the form-operator route; the local item constructs the completion and proves its L2 injection and weak-derivative norm directly.

contents.name: §4.4: Rayleigh quotients and variational eigenvalue bounds
contents.support: The ground lemma proves the normalized-form infimum from the local eigenbasis expansion and attainment; it does not invoke an abstract minimax theorem.

contents.name: §5.1: self-adjoint operators and their strongly continuous unitary groups
contents.support: The local proof writes the group as a spectral series and proves strong continuity and the exact derivative domain.

contents.name: §6.3: trace ideals and traces of positive operators
contents.support: The Gibbs proof establishes summability by oscillator comparison, builds a nuclear series, and invokes the positive trace and basis-independent trace suppliers.

contents.name: §8.3: Hermite functions, ladder operators and oscillator eigenvalues
contents.support: The local lemma rescales the anisotropic oscillator parameters and proves the quadratic-form expansion; the cited imported mathematics theorem supplies its complete product basis.

sources.title: Richard S. Laugesen, Spectral Theory of Partial Differential Equations — Lecture Notes (120 pages, arXiv:1203.2344 version 1)

contents.name: Chapter 3: one-dimensional Hermite oscillator and eigenfunctions
contents.support: The local proof uses the oscillator eigenvalue route and records the exact anisotropic rescaling; completeness is supplied by the inspected published mathematics theorem.

contents.name: Chapter 4: Riesz inverse, compact embedding and discrete spectrum
contents.support: The local proof constructs the Riesz variational inverse, proves compactness from the preceding cube estimate, and diagonalizes that compact positive operator.

contents.name: Chapter 8: compactness for a confining potential using local compactness and coercive tails
contents.support: The source motivates the compactness route; the local proof replaces the generic Rellich step with an explicit cube-mean estimate and finite nets.

contents.name: Chapter 9: Rayleigh quotient and variational eigenvalue comparison
contents.support: The Gibbs proof derives the needed ordered-eigenvalue comparison by a finite-dimensional kernel argument and the exact local oscillator form expansion.
